expires_on.description: For an organisation's connector: the day the provider says this value expires, such as an API key's or a bank certificate's; a check warns 14 days before (C.2 #38). Kept with the value, never changed; absent when it does not expire or nobody knows. An installation's connector takes none.

value.description: The secret's value. It goes to Secret Manager at once and is never shown again (FR-INT-20).
